ABOUT

About me

I am a Mechanical Engineering undergraduate at Knowledge Institute of Technology, Salem, passionate about Mechanical Design, Quality Engineering, and Product Development. Skilled in 3D CAD modeling, engineering drawings, GD&T, and engineering analysis, with experience using Siemens NX, CATIA V5, and SolidWorks.

I aim to apply my technical knowledge and problem-solving skills to develop precise, practical, and manufacturable engineering solutions — a mindset that carries through every project below, from a competition-winning bicycle design to a reverse-engineered assembly and a monitored battery system.

Design a bicycle that folds compactly for storage and transport without giving up structural integrity or rider safety.
